summary.value: Piccola Cucina Uptown is the Upper East Side sibling of the Piccola Cucina group, at 106 East 60th Street, New York, serving fresh seafood, handmade pasta and Sicilian specialties. Restaurantji diners rate it 4.5 1138 ratings and praise both kitchen and floor: Everything they make is delicious and very fresh, with service described as exceptional. It suits a relaxed, conversation-friendly Italian dinner near the park.

claims.text: Everything they make is delicious and very fresh

description.value: Piccola Cucina Uptown is an Italian restaurant, located right across from Central Park. The group invites guests to experience authentic Italian cuisine and indulge in Italian delicacies. It belongs to the Piccola Cucina family, which started with a Sicilian osteria downtown. OpenTable diners rate Piccola Cucina Uptown 4.8 from 2,842 reviews. Restaurantji diners add that They have gluten free bread, pasta and even their eggplant parmesan is gluten free, and one notes the room is comfortable for conversation.
